cadence_scope: primary complete search; sensitivity only on algorithmically selected diagnostic policies, not reoptimized whole grid
objective: unfiltered whole-world conditional sampled path entropy; rate then organized-root offset, ties within1e-9

matched_preparation_reference.support: all full states with both gates service and total modeled energy4
matched_preparation_reference.weights: uniform across physically resolved states in that energy shell
matched_preparation_reference.report: mean conditional bits and centered offsets; do not add preparation entropy
matched_preparation_reference.limits: complete randomized reference within this finite adapter, not a molecular gas ensemble

rule_a.role: optional diagnostic overlay; never primary reward
rule_a.definition: I(X_delta; X_(delta+tau) | X_0=x), averaged over declared roots if needed
rule_a.reference_clock: common base time, unchanged across capture factors and policies
rule_a.units: bits per next stochastic distinction, not cumulative history volume
rule_a.policy_scope: selected diagnostic policies only; no full Rule A optimization claim
rule_a.limitations: retains predictive information, not welfare or organization itself; gate memory counts; no overlapping-lag summation

diagnostic_policy_selection: maximum stationary functioning policy as descriptive benchmark only

predictions.criterion: all protocol policies counted; restricted reachable chains irreducible; probability/Poisson/energy residuals <=declared tolerances
report organized-minus-matched-shell finite and offset advantages at every capture factor; retain negative signs
report winner policy/functioning as capture benefit rises; no assumed monotonicity
winner stationary active total lower than all-service by >1e-8 counts as maintenance trade-off
report whether unfiltered winner also maximizes retained predictive bits among selected policies at each lag/root; identify mismatches without changing primary verdict
report selected-policy ranking flips across cadences; do not infer unchanged global optimum from candidate-only checks
legacy coarse policies reproduce prior finite-state generators; idle has no gate transitions and no fictitious cost
